verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that Fin charges $1 per successful customer session. That points to outcome-based pricing, but no first-party pricing figure, cap, or spend control appears in the pack. The fin.ai/pricing citations list features only, with no rates. Missing for 10: first-party published per-resolution price, documented spending caps or usage controls, a definition of what counts as a resolution, and confirmation that no enterprise quote is required.

support.subject: As a support leader, pricing is outcome-based and published — I pay per resolution with caps and controls, not an opaque enterprise quote

citations.quote: Fin charges $1 per successful customer session, incentivizing it to be helpful
